requirement: The dsh host sends a Model Subscription request's pictures inline, within one request budget, and declares what the pinned model reads

oracle.ref: PR #1234 (feat); fix evidence: Review 09/10/2026: a pasted screenshot or page picture never reached a subscription model; the host posted store references tracy-web cannot read.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. The run request carries {type:'image', source:{type:'base64'}} after a text handle, and no 'attachment' reference; the caller's messages are not mutated. 25 pictures of 512 KiB base64 each fail with IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED and failure.offloadImages = 9; the retry with 9 offloaded reads 16 pictures, sends 16 images and 9 placeholders. The same reference twice is read once and counted twice; 21 occurrences need 1 offload. A picture above 1 MiB is asked again at 1536 then 1024, and kept at 1024. A fallback to the deployment default streams the original reference messages. A pin with route.inputModalities ['text','image'] makes seat-plan-claude declare image before the route reaches dsh; glm, a silent or malformed pin, and a cold host declare ['text']. view.mjs agentReadsImages and look.mjs readsImages are true on a Claude route and false on GLM.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
